== Title ==
<span lang="ja">Ｙウイング</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-147o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットまたは乗客を１名追加してよい。能力値１の専属パイロットが乗っている。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">機体構造がむき出しの反乱同盟軍の戦闘機。ＢＴＬ－Ｓ３型は、砲術士の座席がある。全長１６ｍ。コーンセイヤー社製造。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Y-wing.

'''Card text:''' May add one pilot or passenger. Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' A Rebel Alliance fighter with an exposed airframe. The BTL-S3 model has a gunner's seat. It is 16 meters long and was made by Koensayr.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3
* '''Printed subtype:''' Starfighter
* '''Power:''' 2
* '''Maneuver:''' 3
* '''Hyperspeed:''' 4
* '''Deploy:''' 1
* '''Forfeit:''' 2

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
